title: Who We Are
narration: Apex Affinity Group is a national insurance marketing organization that provides independent life and health insurance agents with top-tier carrier contracts, advanced training, and technology tools to help them succeed. Founded in two thousand eighteen, they now support agents across all fifty states.
slidePrompt: background with map of the United States

title: Why It Matters
narration: This support means you can better serve your clients while experiencing significant financial growth. The right guidance and resources can make a world of difference in your career.

title: What We Offer
narration: Apex provides street-level and above contracts with over forty-five A-rated carriers. Plus, there are no production requirements, so you can keep your contracts even if you take a month off. This flexibility helps reduce pressure while still offering robust support.
slidePrompt: background with icons of support and flexibility

title: Agent Success Stories
narration: Agents like Maria Gonzalez have seen remarkable success, increasing her income from eighty thousand to one hundred eighty-five thousand dollars in her first year. James Patterson experienced a transformation in his business, gaining access to multiple carriers that allowed him to better serve his clients.

narration: With the Apex Connect CRM, agents can manage leads, track policies, and automate follow-ups efficiently. The e-App integration with over thirty carriers simplifies quoting and submissions, helping you save time and increase productivity.
